name: North Island, a Luxury Collection Resort, Seychelles
insider_take: This exclusive private island sanctuary offers the ultimate Robinson Crusoe fantasy with barefoot luxury on one of the world's most pristine tropical paradises.
whats_special: North Island is home to just 11 handcrafted villas on a 500-acre private island that was meticulously restored to its original ecological state. The resort famously hosted Prince William and Catherine's honeymoon, and each villa features its own stretch of beach with butler service. The island serves as a conservation success story, protecting rare species like the Seychelles white-eye bird and giant tortoises that roam freely around the property.
pro_tip: Book the Presidential Villa for the ultimate splurge – it spans two acres with its own spa pavilion, wine cellar, and 180-degree ocean views from your infinity pool.
dont_miss: Snorkel directly off your villa deck to discover vibrant coral gardens, take a sunset cruise to spot dolphins, and visit the island's nursery where baby giant tortoises are raised. The helicopter transfer from Mahé offers breathtaking aerial views of the granite islands scattered like emeralds across the Indian Ocean.
pros: Ultra-exclusive private island with only 11 luxury villas
World-class conservation efforts protecting rare wildlife and ecosystems
Pristine white sand beaches with crystal-clear turquoise waters
Exceptional personalized service with dedicated villa hosts
cons: Ultra-premium pricing reflecting exclusive private island experience
Remote location requires helicopter transfer from main island
